speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the emergency department. I see you are bringing in a newborn with respiratory distress; tell me, how old is the baby in hours or days, and exactly when did these breathing difficulties start?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

Given the baby's prematurity at 33 weeks and the onset of distress just two hours after birth, this is highly suggestive of RDS due to surfactant deficiency. I am requesting a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis and assess lung involvement.
